items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: And then the teacher in the Pasadena was a Mr. Parker.

ctx.x: Do you remember how to spell the name?

N-e-p-e-r-t, I think, Miss Nepert. And then the teacher in the Pasadena was a Mr. Parker. And an interesting feature there was that his wife played cello and she used to come and sit in with the class quite often and play along with us.
